items.source: The default implementation delegates to TestContextSpringFactoriesUtils.loadFactoryImplementations(Class).
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 TestContextSpringFactoriesUtils.loadFactoryImplementations(Class)。

items.source: If @TestExecutionListeners is not present on the test class in the BootstrapContext, default listeners should be returned. Furthermore, default listeners must be sorted using AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.
items.translation: 如果 `BootstrapContext` 中的测试类上不存在 `@TestExecutionListeners`，则应返回默认监听器。此外，必须使用 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator 对默认监听器进行排序。

items.source: The inheritListeners flag of @TestExecutionListeners must be taken into consideration. Specifically, if the inheritListeners flag is set to true, listeners declared for a given test class must be appended to the end of the list of listeners declared in superclasses or enclosing classes.
items.translation: `inheritListeners` 标志必须予以考虑。具体而言，如果 `inheritListeners` 标志设置为 `true`，则声明于给定测试类的监听器必须追加到父类或封装类中声明的监听器列表末尾。

items.source: If the user has not explicitly declared which loader to use, the value returned from getDefaultContextLoaderClass(Class) will be used as the default context loader class. For details on the class resolution process, see resolveExplicitContextLoaderClass(List) and getDefaultContextLoaderClass(Class).
items.translation: 如果用户未显式声明要使用的加载器，则将从 getDefaultContextLoaderClass(Class) 返回的值用作默认上下文加载器类。有关类解析过程的详细信息，请参阅 resolveExplicitContextLoaderClass(List) 和 getDefaultContextLoaderClass(Class)。

items.source: To plug in custom ContextCache support, override getCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate().
items.translation: 要插入自定义的ContextCache支持，请重写getCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate()。

items.source: Concrete implementations are free to determine what comprises the set of default listeners. However, by default, the Spring TestContext Framework will use the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism to look up all TestExecutionListener class names configured in all META-INF/spring.factories files on the classpath.
items.translation: 具体实现可以自由确定默认监听器的集合。然而，默认情况下，Spring TestContext 框架将使用SpringFactoriesLoader机制来查找类路径上所有META-INF/spring.factories文件中配置的TestExecutionListener类名。

items.source: Note that the implementation of TestContextBootstrapper.buildTestContext() should typically delegate to this method when constructing the TestContext.
items.translation: 注意，TestContextBootstrapper.buildTestContext() 的实现通常应在构建 TestContext 时委托给此方法。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to getBootstrapContext().getCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate() and the default one will load ApplicationContextFailureProcessor via the service loading mechanism.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给getBootstrapContext().getCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate()，且默认实现将通过服务加载机制加载ApplicationContextFailureProcessor。
